name: Molly Breckenridge
source: Wife of the main character. Molly is a teacher at Saint Gloria's high school and has been married to her husband for 12 years. She has fantasized about the protagonist with another woman, but she constantly dismisses it, shunting her fantasy to the back of her mind and pretending it's not there.
